From the owner
A successful kitchen remodel starts long before the first cabinet is removed. Careful planning can help you create a kitchen that looks great, functions efficiently, and fits the way you use your home. Before starting your kitchen renovation, consider: • Your layout: Think about how you move between cooking, cleaning, dining, and storage areas. • Storage needs: Plan cabinets, drawers, pantry space, and organization around your everyday needs. • Materials: Choose countertops, flooring, cabinets, and fixtures based on both appearance and durability. • Lighting: Combine task, ambient, and accent lighting to make the kitchen more comfortable and functional. • Appliances: Consider appliance placement and how new equipment will work with your overall layout. • Budget and timeline: Establish realistic expectations before construction begins. At 4 Edges Construction, we provide kitchen remodeling services throughout Vacaville, Fairfield, Napa, Davis, Dixon, and Sacramento. Our team works with homeowners to plan and build kitchens that combine functionality, craftsmanship, and a design that fits their needs. Thinking about remodeling your kitchen? Start with a plan that works for your home and your lifestyle.
